description: Defines the EmployeeLeaveSearchFilterParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for filtering employee leave searches within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties and methods for setting date ranges, employee number, leave statuses, and inclusion criteria for employees.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee leave search results, including date range, status, employee number, and inclusion options.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of leave statuses set for filtering.

methods.name: setStatuses
methods.description: Sets the leave statuses for filtering, validating against allowed statuses and mapping them via a service.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date for the leave search filter.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the leave search filter.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date for the leave search filter.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the leave search filter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the inclusion criteria for employees.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion criteria for employees.
